Workflow 00b-framework_selection.json spent nine actions on the choice: analyse system semantics first, evaluate EVERY framework rather than picking one, map which analyses each framework enables or blocks, score against objective criteria, present the recommendation, and require the user to EXPLICITLY CONFIRM before proceeding.
